name: cheaper-app-tests
description: Test harness for the Cheaper.app repo. NOT published — the npm package is cli/package.json, whose `files` list ships only bin/, src/ and assets/. Playwright lives here so the shipped package keeps its empty dependency tree. Two script notes, because JSON cannot carry comments: (1) test:gateway names cli/assets/gateway/tests, the REAL path — `gateway/` is a git-tracked symlink to it, which a Windows checkout without symlink support and a `git archive`/source-zip export both materialise as a plain text file, so `gateway/tests` is not a directory there and pytest collects nothing; (2) test:e2e:report passes .playwright-report explicitly, because playwright.config.js sets the html reporter's outputFolder to .playwright-report while `playwright show-report` with no argument looks in playwright-report and exits 1 with 'No report found'.

scripts.test:all: npm run test:cli && npm run test:gateway && npm run test:e2e
